empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: This becomes part of the agent's prompt as instructions, at the same trust level as your system prompt. Read it before you enable it.
file.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you read and enable it.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

editor.runEvalsTooltip: Skill evals arrive in L06 — the runner is not built yet.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.nameHint: A slug — lowercase letters, digits and dashes. It names the file and the prompt heading.
config.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. pr-quality-rubric.
config.nameTaken: A skill named "{name}" already exists in this workspace.
config.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface — write it imperatively ("Flag any test that asserts only the happy path"), not descriptively ("This skill is about test coverage").

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.title: PREVIEW
preview.hint: This is exactly the block the run executor injects into the agent's prompt.

evals.title: Evals
evals.emptyBody: Eval cases already accept a skill owner in the schema; running them is a later lesson. Nothing here is wired yet.

stats.pullHint: of runs by agents linked to this skill
stats.acceptHint: judged findings only — unjudged are excluded from both sides
stats.agentsEmpty: No agent uses this skill yet.
stats.findingsTitle: Findings in runs using this skill
stats.findingsHint: Attribution is run-level: a run that injected four skills counts its findings toward all four. This is not "findings caused by this skill".
stats.findingsEmpty: No findings recorded in runs that used this skill.
stats.loadError: Could not load stats for this skill.

versions.title: Versions
versions.hint: Append-only. Saving a changed body archives the previous one here; there is no restore.
versions.empty: No earlier versions yet. Saving a changed body archives the previous one here.
versions.selectPrompt: Select a version on the left to compare it with the current body.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: Read a Markdown file or a .zip. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.fileHint: A .md file, or a .zip containing a SKILL.md. Only that one file is read — scripts, hooks and binaries in the archive are never extracted or run.
import.ignoredEntries: {count, plural, =0 {No other entries in this upload} =1 {1 other entry was not read} other {# other entries were not read}}
import.candidates: More than one SKILL.md was found; the first was used: {paths}
import.collides: A skill named "{name}" already exists — rename it below before importing.
import.arrivesDisabled: Imported skills arrive disabled with a "needs vetting" badge until you read the body and enable it.
